question: JEPX 区域电价为什么在不同时间和地区表现不同？
claim_type: historical attribution / 事后历史解释
statement: 这些结果用于解释历史共变关系，不证明因果关系。
actual_inputs_notice: 负荷、出力、限发和联络线使用事后实绩；不能提前用于预测。

quality.hourly_aggregation: equal-duration arithmetic mean of exactly two native30min MW and price observations; not kWh sums

time_alignment.kyushu: DATE+TIME interval end00:30..24:00; subtract30min within source DATE, map row48 to23:30 of same date
time_alignment.basis: B convention resolved from complete48-row source days and00:30/24:00 endpoint sequence; source strings retained

interchange_sign.normalized: positive net import, negative net export
interchange_sign.kyushu_native: positive export; negate according to official page CSV note (not graph legend)
interchange_sign.source_locator: CSVデータ項目の「連系線」については九州からの送電方向を正
interchange_sign.validation: native fuel, storage and interchange components reconcile to official supply total; raw signs and preliminary demand residual retained

quality.preliminary_notice: 九州2026年9月文件取回时未标確報，包含推計实绩；供给合计与需求差额原样保留。前月实绩通常在翌月末覆盖更新，当前快照不替代最终值。中部公告也可能含速報与推計实绩。
quality.missing_policy: no imputation, no zero fill; exclude incomplete observation/pair/day as recorded
not_included: 天气与气温：未引入第三方插补
燃料成本与机组可用容量：当前使用的是出力实绩，不能替代可用容量
其余三个区域：本轮未建立同质量供需快照
quality.revision_policy: Chubu provisional values may be revised; Kyushu confirmed fuel-mix public CSV also may be revised without earlier vintages. Snapshots frozen at retrieval, not known-in-advance publication archives.

model_spec.target: hourly arithmetic mean regional JEPX price
model_spec.permutation: shuffle complete daily24h profiles within holdout calendar month; preserve hour order; one driver at a time
model_spec.partial_response: linear controlled contrast relative to feature P50 at holdoutP10/P25/P50/P75/P90; not causal or guaranteed feasible joint supply state
